ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white/grey mottling is clustered in the distal regions (outer 20% of lobe width) of both lobes; the central/proximal region is a contiguous block of low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular serrations with high frequency and variable pixel-amplitude (peaks) across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a tapered horizontal sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle vertical linear pixel interruptions visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serrated profile on the trailing edge indicating minor historic tissue loss or developmental variance.
